text: Bitcoin's modest 2.3% decline is holding better than Ethereum's 4.2% drop, signaling cautious risk-off sentiment where traders are rotating toward the largest asset. The Fear & Greed index at 51 (neutral) with a declining 7-day trend suggests uncertainty is creeping in despite no panic, while BTC dominance at 59.6% reflects this flight-to-safety pattern. Volume at $63B remains solid but hasn't spiked, indicating measured selling rather than capitulation or euphoria.
